title: 祭りは準備が肝要ってな

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Inari One is upset when she realizes some of her classmates think she transferred to Tracen because she was too good for regional races.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's determined to prove regional racers aren't inferior to their central counterparts. But as she is now, her claims will only fall on deaf ears.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Inari One becomes driven to make a real name for herself, so people can't possibly ignore her when she declares that the regionals are in no way lesser than the central races!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With a new goal decided, we start training for Inari One's junior year.
